tei:div.tei:p: gcod yul bdud rtsi kun khyab kyi ngag 'don bzhugs so/ 404) phaṭaḥ rang nyid kyi spyi bor drin can rje// sangs rgyas kyi khyab bdag bla ma mchog /byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi lam se lam// gsol 'debs kyi bu la byin gyis rlobasaḥ phaṭaḥ rang rig 'di bla ma'i thugs kar bstim// chos dbyings su gzod nas ro gcig pa'i// bla ma yang 'od du ltem gyi zhu// bdag lus dang gnyis med bdud rtsi 'khyil// phaṭaḥ lus zhu bas bdud rtsi rgya mtsho las// 'od rlangs pa lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin// zhing kun khyab rab 'byams rgyal ba mchod// byin rlabs dang dngos grub char 405) chen babs/ phaṭaḥ stong gsum kun gang zhing 'khyil ba yi// ci 'dod bzhin lhun grub bdud rtsi 'di// khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la// pham rgyal dang nye ring med par sbyin// phaṭaḥ sbyin yul dang sbyin mkhan sbyin bya kun// rang sems kyi rnam 'gyur sgyu 'phrul las//a 'thas kyi zhen 'dzin spros pas dben// gang shar kun chos skur khro lo lau// mchog dman gyi dgra gnyen dang*// phan byed kyi lha dang gnod byed 'dre// tha snyad kyi ming tsam rnam rtog gi /bden zhen kun 406) gtad med du ya la la// cir snang kun rang sems thag chod pas// 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gang du song*// 'jigs skrag gi sprul sems kyi dngos po rnams// rang rig gi klong grol du shigs se shig /snang grags kun rgyal ba'i zhing khams nyid// tshogs drug kun chos nyid kyi rol ba la// dgag sgrub kyi mtshan ma ye nas bral// blo 'das kyi mtshan ma kun e ma ho/

/gcod yul chen mo'i ngang nas/ sgyu lus mchog sbyin bdud rtsi kun khyab nam mkha'i thig pa ces bya ba'i nyams len rgyun khyer ngag 'don 'di nyid nor bzang chos kyi dbang pos bskul ngor/ rgod phug bya skyibs kyi gnas su bris pa maṅgal lam/
